applies_to: Intelligent Lighting Controls Advanced BACnet/IP Gateway for LightLEEDer and LL-EVO lighting relay panels (one of four panel groups, up to 64 panels).
summary: The ILC Advanced BACnet/IP gateway exposes a LightLEEDer panel group: 64 network relay groups and 64 presets (BVs 1-128) plus a global scene AV, and for each of up to 64 panels a block of LightSync inputs (BI), relays and scenes (BV) and PC/dimmer/VDI and dimmer levels (AV). This list has the group block and the printed panel 01 block; other panels repeat it at +1000 per panel.
notes: Panel points repeat for every panel: object ID = panel number x 1000 + point (panel 01 = 1001-1128, panel 40 hex = 64001...). Only the printed panel 01 block is listed.
Names are printed with all four panel-group prefixes (PNL01/41/81/C1); on a real gateway the name carries the one hex panel number for the selected panel group.
Group and preset numbers likewise show four values (e.g. Group 001/065/129/193) for panel groups 1-4; the object IDs stay the same.
Access per the mapping: AV and BV read/write, BI read only.
The 132-page document prints all 64 panel blocks; they differ only in names and IDs.

source.title: Intelligent Lighting Controls Vendor Protocol Mappings

integration.summary: Switch lighting through the relay group BVs (1-64) or presets (65-128); use the per-panel relay BVs and LightSync BIs for panel-level control and status.
setup: Set the gateway to one of four panel groups; IDs stay the same, the groups/presets/panels they refer to shift.
gotchas: Each panel adds about 230 objects; only map the panels and devices that exist.
